notes.title: USGS Flood Inundation Mapper site catalog (187 sites)
notes.finding: The catalog query on 2026-11-02 returned 187 sites. USGS 01401000 Stony Brook at Princeton is not in it. No site title or community contains Stony Brook, Princeton, Millstone, or Carnegie Lake. The seven New Jersey libraries are Delaware at Trenton, three Saddle River sites, Hohokus Brook, Peckman River, and Cape May Harbor.

notes.title: NOAA stage-based CatFIM site layer
notes.finding: A query for AHPS pctn4 and USGS 01401000 returned no site. Action, minor, moderate, major, and record polygons intersect the municipal polygon in 0 features. Nearby mapped gages are Millstone at Blackwells Mills, Assunpink at Trenton, and the Delaware. Those are polygons of a flood category, not a depth raster and not an Ida time.

notes.title: NOAA National Water Model analysis inundation extent
notes.finding: The experimental analysis layer is a polygon of current high-water extent, not a depth raster and not an archived Ida surface. A spatial query of the municipal polygon on 2026-11-02 returned 0 features. It was not sampled.

notes.title: FEMA hosted Mercer County, New Jersey flood-hazard layers
notes.finding: Mercer_County_Effective_Flood_Hazard_Zones is a polygon feature layer. Mercer_County_NJ_Effective_Base_Flood_Elevations is a polyline feature layer whose layer name says NGVD29. Neither is a depth raster. A spatial count against the Princeton envelope returned a service error, so intersection was not measured. No depth was sampled from them. They are not Hurricane Ida observations.

notes.title: USGS ScienceBase catalog search
notes.finding: Queries for flood inundation at Stony Brook Princeton, Stony Brook at Princeton inundation, Hurricane Ida flood depth New Jersey raster, Millstone River flood inundation depth grid, and Carnegie Lake flood depth each returned total 0.

notes.title: NJDEP Blue Acres mention of a Manville Borough Ida depth grid
notes.finding: The Blue Acres page says Rutgers built Ida flood simulations for Manville. No downloadable raster was found, and the page does not give a file whose extent can be tested. It was not assumed to cover Princeton and was not sampled.

notes.title: USGS New Jersey Ida high-water marks
notes.finding: Point elevations in feet NAVD88. Not a raster. The exposure run recounts how many fall inside the municipal polygon. They are not turned into a depth surface.

notes.title: USGS Pennsylvania Hurricane Ida depth grids
notes.finding: Already tested in data/processed/ida_raster_coverage_check.json. Five grids, none intersecting Princeton. Not reused as a Princeton depth surface.
